group_size.en: Pairs or groups of three; each learner completes a separate sheet.
group_size.fil: Magkapareha o tatluhan; bawat mag-aaral ay pupuno ng sariling papel.

purpose.en: Record observed waste and evidence before proposing a safe response.
purpose.fil: Itala muna ang nakitang aksaya at ebidensya bago magmungkahi ng ligtas na hakbang.

materials.en: Fictional Elena scenario, printed audit sheet and pen
materials.fil: Kathang sitwasyon ni Elena, nakalimbag na audit sheet at panulat

steps.en: Read the fictional BHS case: leaking tap, wrong-version printouts, and supplies bought again because they cannot be found.
steps.fil: Basahin ang kathang BHS: tumutulong gripo, maling bersyon ng printout, at muling pagbili ng kagamitang hindi makita.

steps.en: Each learner writes three separate rows: resource, observation, evidence to check, safe next step, and person to tell. Do not invent a bill or quantity.
steps.fil: Bawat mag-aaral ay magsulat ng tatlong hanay: resource, obserbasyon, ebidensyang susuriin, ligtas na hakbang, at pagsasabihan. Huwag mag-imbento ng bill o dami.

steps.en: Compare sheets, then demonstrate how to check the approved handout version and labeled stock before ordering.
steps.fil: Ihambing ang mga papel, saka ipakita ang pagsuri sa aprubadong bersyon at may-label na stock bago umorder.

debrief.en: Which row needs a real measurement before a savings claim? What service must remain available?
debrief.fil: Aling hanay ang kailangan ng tunay na sukat bago mag-claim ng tipid? Aling serbisyo ang dapat manatili?

observe.en: For each learner, note whether all three observations have evidence and a safe next step. Participation alone is not competency evidence.
observe.fil: Sa bawat mag-aaral, itala kung may ebidensya at ligtas na hakbang ang tatlong obserbasyon. Hindi sapat na ebidensya ng kakayahan ang pagsali.

output.en: Individual three-row audit and one follow-up question for the supervisor.
output.fil: Indibidwal na audit na may tatlong hanay at isang tanong sa supervisor.

alternative.en: Use a seated fictional kit and oral dictation if writing is difficult; capture each learner's answer separately.
alternative.fil: Gumamit ng kathang kit habang nakaupo at pasalitang pagdidikta kung mahirap magsulat; itala nang hiwalay ang sagot ng bawat isa.

worksheet.en: Resource / observation / evidence or measure / safe next step / responsible person
worksheet.fil: Resource / obserbasyon / ebidensya o sukat / ligtas na hakbang / responsable

worksheet.en: Do not use expired stock or an outdated handout to reduce waste.
worksheet.fil: Huwag gumamit ng expired na stock o lumang handout para lang makatipid.

group_size.en: Pairs or groups of three; each learner completes a separate sheet.
group_size.fil: Magkapareha o tatluhan; bawat mag-aaral ay pupuno ng sariling papel.

purpose.en: Test a proposed saving against safety, service quality and local procedure.
purpose.fil: Suriin ang mungkahing pagtitipid laban sa kaligtasan, kalidad ng serbisyo at lokal na proseso.

materials.en: Printed decision sheet, fictional wrong printouts and approved-master label
materials.fil: Nakalimbag na decision sheet, kathang maling printout at label ng aprubadong master

steps.en: Compare repair the leak with reduce handwashing water; compare a reusable teaching visual with reuse of a clinical single-use item.
steps.fil: Ihambing ang pagpapaayos ng tagas sa pagbawas ng tubig sa paghuhugas ng kamay; ihambing ang reusable teaching visual sa muling paggamit ng clinical single-use item.

steps.en: For each option, write the likely saving, possible harm, protected service and local policy or supervisor check. Reject unsafe cuts.
steps.fil: Sa bawat opsyon, isulat ang maaaring tipid, pinsala, serbisyong poprotektahan at lokal na policy o supervisor check. Tanggihan ang di-ligtas na pagbabawas.

steps.en: Role-play explaining the chosen change and two possible causes of wrong printouts. Check the sample against the approved master; ask before changing the routine.
steps.fil: Mag-role-play sa pagpapaliwanag ng napiling pagbabago at dalawang posibleng sanhi ng maling printout. Ihambing ang sample sa aprubadong master; magtanong bago baguhin ang routine.

debrief.en: What would make you stop the trial? Who can confirm the approved local procedure?
debrief.fil: Ano ang dahilan para ihinto ang trial? Sino ang makapagpapatunay ng aprubadong lokal na proseso?

observe.en: Record each learner's cause check, selected safeguard and rejected unsafe option. Never rate a learner from group participation alone.
observe.fil: Itala ang pagsuri ng bawat mag-aaral sa sanhi, napiling proteksyon at tinanggihang di-ligtas na opsyon. Huwag mag-rate batay lamang sa pagsali sa grupo.

output.en: Individual decision sheet and a short explanation to the supervisor.
output.fil: Indibidwal na decision sheet at maikling paliwanag sa supervisor.

alternative.en: Use a written choice and explanation if role-play is unsuitable; seek the same individual evidence.
alternative.fil: Gumamit ng nakasulat na pagpili at paliwanag kung hindi angkop ang role-play; kunin pa rin ang indibidwal na ebidensya.

worksheet.en: Option / saving / possible harm / protected service / policy check / decision and reason
worksheet.fil: Opsyon / tipid / posibleng pinsala / serbisyong protektado / policy check / pasya at dahilan

worksheet.en: Protected: hand hygiene, clinical single-use rules, cold chain, urgent referrals and service quality.
worksheet.fil: Protektado: hand hygiene, clinical single-use rules, cold chain, agarang referral at kalidad ng serbisyo.

group_size.en: Pairs or groups of three; each learner completes a separate sheet.
group_size.fil: Magkapareha o tatluhan; bawat mag-aaral ay pupuno ng sariling papel.

title.fil: Suriin ang ligtas na resource trial

purpose.en: Compare a normalized measure with service quality and explain a review decision.
purpose.fil: Ihambing ang patas na sukat sa kalidad ng serbisyo at ipaliwanag ang pasya sa review.

materials.en: Printed fictional trial data and review sheet
materials.fil: Nakalimbag na kathang datos at review sheet

steps.en: Use the fictional example: wrong-version reprints fall from 20 of 100 pages to 5 of 100. Calculate both percentages and the change per 100 pages.
steps.fil: Gamitin ang kathang halimbawa: bumaba ang maling-bersyong reprint mula 20 sa 100 pahina tungo sa 5 sa 100. Kwentahin ang parehong porsiyento at pagbabago bawat 100 pahina.

steps.en: Record the owner, approved-master check, review date, session workload, correct-material check and any delays. Do not use patient names.
steps.fil: Itala ang responsable, approved-master check, petsa ng review, dami ng session, pagsuri sa tamang materyal at anumang delay. Huwag gumamit ng pangalan ng pasyente.

steps.en: A colleague has no internet. Explain the controlled paper master, handover and how feedback changes the plan. Each learner reports a decision.
steps.fil: Walang internet ang isang kasama. Ipaliwanag ang controlled paper master, handover at paano babaguhin ng puna ang plano. Bawat mag-aaral ay mag-ulat ng pasya.

debrief.en: Can a lower raw total be called a success when there were fewer sessions or delayed teaching?
debrief.fil: Matawag bang tagumpay ang mas mababang total kung mas kaunti ang session o naantala ang pagtuturo?

observe.en: Check each learner's arithmetic, workload comparison, quality check, owner and feedback response separately.
observe.fil: Suriin nang hiwalay ang kwenta, paghahambing ng workload, quality check, responsable at tugon sa puna ng bawat mag-aaral.

output.en: Individual trial-and-review sheet with a continue, revise or stop decision.
output.fil: Indibidwal na trial-and-review sheet na may pasyang ipagpatuloy, baguhin o ihinto.

alternative.en: Allow a spoken calculation with a scribe; preserve the learner's own reasoning and decision.
alternative.fil: Payagan ang pasalitang kwenta na may tagasulat; panatilihin ang sariling paliwanag at pasya ng mag-aaral.

worksheet.en: Problem / change / owner / before numerator and denominator / after numerator and denominator / workload / quality or delay / feedback / review date / decision
worksheet.fil: Problema / pagbabago / responsable / dati: bilang at kabuuan / pagkatapos: bilang at kabuuan / workload / kalidad o delay / puna / petsa ng review / pasya

worksheet.en: Expected fictional calculation: 20% to 5%, down 15 percentage points or 15 reprints per 100 pages.
worksheet.fil: Inaasahang kwenta sa kathang datos: 20% tungong 5%, bawas na 15 percentage points o 15 reprint bawat 100 pahina.
